dungeons.name: The Sewers of [town_name]
dungeons.description: A damp network of tunnels beneath the town. Smells exactly as expected. Then worse.

dungeons.name: The Spirited Wood
dungeons.description: Old growth that predates the town. The trees remember things. Some of them object to visitors.

dungeons.name: The Crystal Toad Cave
dungeons.description: A cave system lit by mineral formations of unknown origin. The toads are a secondary concern.

dungeons.name: The Silken Pit
dungeons.description: A descent into silk-covered darkness. Something large lives at the bottom. Several things live above it.

dungeons.name: The Ruined Fort
dungeons.description: A crumbling stronghold. Dangerous warriors have claimed it. They were not asked.

dungeons.name: The Dragon Sanctum
dungeons.description: An ancient lair. Few return with their lives. Fewer with their dignity.
